title: Kahlil Gibran — The Prophet (New York: Alfred A. Knopf, 1923), with the Author's Twelve Drawings
edition: The Prophet (New York: Alfred A. Knopf, 1923) — the Gutenberg text is taken from a later Knopf printing: its front matter carries an epigraph from Claude Bragdon and a list of the author's books running to Nymphs of the Valley (1948); the text of the book is the 1923 text. With the Gutenberg HTML edition carrying the author's twelve drawings

license.payload: Public domain in the United States (first published 1923; public domain since 1 January 2019) and in the EU (Gibran d. 1931). Written by Gibran in English, its original language. The later printing's front matter (the Bragdon epigraph, a list of the author's books) is recorded as it stands and adds nothing to the book's text. Project Gutenberg packaging under the PG licence.

normalization: Project Gutenberg texts stripped at the START/END markers, CRLF to LF, otherwise unaltered; Internet Archive OCR text layers as fetched, uncorrected (text/<slug>.ocr.txt) — the scan under original/<identifier>/ is the witness; Ganjoor JSON as fetched, rendered one couplet per line, hemistichs joined by ' / ', section titles marked '=== title ==='.
scope: The book entire, all twenty-six sermons with the coming of the ship and the farewell, and the twelve drawings. Gibran's Arabic works are not seated in this pass; The Prophet's original language is English.
verified_loci: The opening — 'Almustafa, the chosen and the beloved'
On Children — 'Your children are not your children.'
why_seated: Asked for in full. A book of sayings delivered by a departing teacher to a city that kept him twelve years: the farewell discourse as a genre, beside the Gospel of John the archive reads in its own seats.
ruling: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-18: "did we ever seat the medieval pearl poem in the originals library?" — "rumi, too - and gibran's the prophet if its public domain" — "and blake" — "yes, original language where available always, the prophet full, and lets do illuminated books as text to start. we can group those all in a single ea-corpora deposit, refer to examples, and they also do to alexanarch data and get spines and cards on traininglayerliterature's originals library".
